epics.name: Customer account data export
epics.description: Let support agents export the data of a customer account to answer customer requests. Format, content, access rights and delivery are not decided yet.

stories.iWant: to export the data of a customer account
stories.title: Export a customer account's data
stories.description: A support agent exports the data of a customer account. Open points from the spec: format (CSV, JSON or ZIP archive), encoding and delimiter, allowed roles (support level 1, level 2, admins), included fields (GDPR review pending), delivery (browser or e-mail) and size limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an authorized support agent, When they request the export of a customer account, Then they receive the account's data in the format and with the content still to be decided
Given a user whose role is not authorized, When they request the export of a customer account, Then the export is refused
stories.aiReadyReason: Which fields of the customer account must the export contain once the GDPR review is complete?

tasks.title: Check the export permission
tasks.description: Restrict the export to the allowed roles. Depends on the missing decision: the list of roles from Legal.

tasks.title: Collect the account data
tasks.description: Gather the customer account data. Depends on the missing decision: the field list validated by the GDPR review.

tasks.title: Produce and deliver the export file
tasks.description: Generate and deliver the file. Depends on the missing decisions: format, encoding, delivery and size limits.

tasks.title: Test the export and the access control
tasks.description: Tests for an authorized role and for the refusal of an unauthorized role.
